verdict.rationale: The ledger skill documents single-record operations: create, MARK a status, and ARCHIVE one record. It also offers list filters (status, tag, exclude) and a topological ORDER of open tasks, but nothing shows applying an action to many matched items at once. The Ralph loop is explicitly scoped to exactly one assigned task. The 'install all skills' and 'update all three agent copies' commands only manage the skills themselves, not bulk operations on the user's work items.
